1 // bin/stakes.mjs — Wave 4 Phase-1 seam: the adjudicated STAKES VECTOR → governor tier.
2 //
3 // MASTER-PLAN Phase A: "Emit a stakes vector (captures irreversibility; reviewer-checkable;
4 // irreversible ⇒ tier ≥ medium), projected to a governor tier." IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN Wave 4:
5 // "Given reversibility='irreversible', Then tier ≥ medium (I6); raw vector persisted (no schema
6 // break)."
7 //
8 // The honesty lever here is I6 ("no gamed gates"): the stakes that scale the whole verification
9 // loop must NOT be whatever the author casually declared — the vector is ADJUDICATED. The author's
10 // declaration is one axis among several, and an irreversible action forces the governor tier up to
11 // at least `medium` even when the author declared it `low` (the under-call guard the fixture's
12 // `declared-low-but-irreversible` probe exists to catch). Every upgrade is recorded in `overrides`
13 // so the adjudication is reviewer-checkable, not a black box.
14 //
15 // This module is PURE: `adjudicateStakes` is a deterministic function of its input (no clock, no
16 // randomness), and it NEVER mutates the caller's input — the raw declared vector is copied verbatim
17 // onto the result so a downstream consumer that only knows the declared axes still reads them
18 // unchanged (the "no schema break": adjudication is strictly ADDITIVE).
19 
20 // ── Tier ladder (ordinal) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
21 // The governor tier the rest of the engine scales by. Ordered low < medium < high.
22 export const TIERS = Object.freeze(['low', 'medium', 'high']);
23 
24 /** Ordinal rank of a tier; -1 for an unknown tier (so unknowns never silently win a max). */
25 export function tierRank(tier) {
26   return TIERS.indexOf(tier);
27 }
28 
29 /** The higher of two tiers (the projection combinator). Throws on an unknown tier. */
30 export function maxTier(a, b) {
31   const ra = tierRank(a);
32   const rb = tierRank(b);
33   if (ra < 0) throw new RangeError(`unknown tier: ${JSON.stringify(a)}`);
34   if (rb < 0) throw new RangeError(`unknown tier: ${JSON.stringify(b)}`);
35   return ra >= rb ? a : b;
36 }
37 
38 /** Whether `tier` is at least `floor` on the ladder (the ≥ comparison crit-tests assert). */
39 export function tierAtLeast(tier, floor) {
40   const rt = tierRank(tier);
41   const rf = tierRank(floor);
42   if (rt < 0) throw new RangeError(`unknown tier: ${JSON.stringify(tier)}`);
43   if (rf < 0) throw new RangeError(`unknown floor: ${JSON.stringify(floor)}`);
44   return rt >= rf;
45 }
46 
47 // ── The stakes axes: each maps a declared value to the tier it justifies ───────────────────────
48 // Reviewer-checkable: a reviewer can read each axis's contribution and the projection rule.
49 // `reversibility` carries the I6 floor — `irreversible` justifies AT LEAST `medium` regardless of
50 // the author's declared stakes (it is the under-call guard, not merely another input).
51 const AXIS_TIER_MAPS = Object.freeze({
52   declared_stakes: { low: 'low', medium: 'medium', high: 'high' },
53   reversibility: { reversible: 'low', 'hard-to-reverse': 'medium', irreversible: 'medium' },
54   blast_radius: { narrow: 'low', moderate: 'medium', wide: 'high' },
55   magnitude: { minor: 'low', moderate: 'medium', major: 'high' },
56 });
57 
58 /** The recognized stakes-vector axes, in a stable order (for reviewer-facing rationale). */
59 export const STAKES_AXES = Object.freeze(Object.keys(AXIS_TIER_MAPS));
60 
61 // Irreversibility forces the governor tier to AT LEAST this (I6; IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN Wave 4).
62 export const IRREVERSIBLE_FLOOR = 'medium';
63 
64 /**
65  * Map one axis value to the tier it justifies. An unrecognized value for a known axis contributes
66  * nothing (`low`) — it can never silently RAISE the tier, only the recognized scale words can — so
67  * a typo'd or novel value fails safe (no spurious upgrade) and is left for a reviewer to catch.
68  */
69 function axisTier(axis, value) {
70   const map = AXIS_TIER_MAPS[axis];
71   if (!map) return 'low';
72   return map[value] ?? 'low';
73 }
74 
75 /**
76  * Adjudicate a declared stakes input into a governor tier (I6).
77  *
78  * @param {object} input the declared stakes vector — any of {declared_stakes, reversibility,
79  *   blast_radius, magnitude}, plus an optional `id`/extra fields (preserved verbatim).
80  * @returns {{
81  *   id: string|undefined,
82  *   raw: object,                       // the caller's declared vector, copied verbatim (no schema break)
83  *   axis_tiers: Record<string,string>, // each recognized axis's tier contribution (reviewer-checkable)
84  *   declared_tier: string,             // what the author's `declared_stakes` alone would have set
85  *   tier: string,                      // the adjudicated governor tier (the projection)
86  *   overrides: Array<{axis,from,to,reason}>, // every upgrade above the declared tier (auditable)
87  *   rationale: string,
88  * }}
89  */
90 export function adjudicateStakes(input) {
91   if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input)) {
92     throw new TypeError('adjudicateStakes requires a stakes-vector object');
93   }
94 
95   // Per-axis tier contributions (only for axes the caller actually declared).
96   const axis_tiers = {};
97   for (const axis of STAKES_AXES) {
98     if (input[axis] !== undefined) axis_tiers[axis] = axisTier(axis, input[axis]);
99   }
100 
101   // The author's self-declaration alone (the number the under-call guard must beat).
102   const declared_tier = input.declared_stakes !== undefined
103     ? axisTier('declared_stakes', input.declared_stakes)
104     : 'low';
105 
106   // Projection: the highest tier any declared axis justifies.
107   let tier = 'low';
108   for (const t of Object.values(axis_tiers)) tier = maxTier(tier, t);
109 
110   // I6 under-call guard (defensive floor): irreversibility forces tier ≥ medium regardless of the
111   // axis map (so the floor survives even if the reversibility scale is ever re-tuned).
112   if (input.reversibility === 'irreversible') tier = maxTier(tier, IRREVERSIBLE_FLOOR);
113 
114   // Record every axis (other than the author's own declaration) that pushed the governor tier ABOVE
115   // the author's declared tier, so a reviewer sees exactly WHY the governor over-rode the author.
116   // The canonical case is the irreversibility floor beating a `low` declaration (the under-call
117   // guard); the same loop also catches e.g. a `wide` blast_radius beating a `low` declaration.
118   const overrides = [];
119   for (const axis of STAKES_AXES) {
120     if (axis === 'declared_stakes') continue;
121     const at = axis_tiers[axis];
122     if (!at || tierRank(at) <= tierRank(declared_tier)) continue;
123     const reason =
124       axis === 'reversibility' && input.reversibility === 'irreversible'
125         ? `reversibility='irreversible' forces tier ≥ ${IRREVERSIBLE_FLOOR} (I6 under-call guard)`
126         : `${axis}='${input[axis]}' justifies tier ${at}, above the declared ${declared_tier}`;
127     overrides.push({ axis, from: declared_tier, to: at, reason });
128   }
129 
130   const rationale =
131     `adjudicated governor tier=${tier} (declared=${declared_tier})` +
132     (overrides.length ? `; upgraded by: ${overrides.map((o) => o.axis).join(', ')}` : '; no upgrade');
133 
134   return {
135     id: input.id,
136     raw: { ...input }, // verbatim copy — additive adjudication, never mutates the declared vector
137     axis_tiers,
138     declared_tier,
139     tier,
140     overrides,
141     rationale,
142   };
143 }
